cues: A linear molecule cut at three sites gives four pieces; a circular plasmid cut at three sites gives only three, because a ring has no ends.
Either way, the fragment sizes must add back up to the whole molecule, twelve kilobases here.
And two fragments of the same size run together as one brighter band.
